name: VirtualPad
author: mudbourn
description: Controller input simulation. Clones the connected controller as a virtual HID device, forwards its real input and lets macros press buttons and move sticks through ms.vpad.*. On macOS needs SIP off with AMFI disabled (amfi_get_out_of_my_way=0x1). On Windows needs the ViGEmBus driver, and HidHide to hide the real pad.
